announcement.message:
🎉 أهلاً وسهلاً بكم في مكتبة الروضة!

يسرّنا إطلاق التطبيق رسمياً اليوم — منصة مجانية لطلب العلم الشرعي، صدقة جارية لوجه الله تعالى.

📚 ما يحتويه التطبيق:
• كتب PDF أصيلة في: الفقه، الحديث، العقيدة، اللغة العربية والتجويد، والسيرة النبوية
• شروحات صوتية من العلماء والمشايخ المعتمدين
• القرآن الكريم كاملاً — 114 سورة مع تلاوات لعشرة قرّاء، وعدة مصاحف (ملون، غير ملون، المدينة، قطر)
• الأجزاء الثلاثون من القرآن الكريم
• جداول محتويات مفصّلة لكل كتاب
• حفظ تقدّم القراءة والعلامات
• العمل بدون إنترنت بعد التحميل

🌿 كل المحتوى مجاني بالكامل — لا اشتراكات، لا إعلانات.

نسأل الله تعالى أن يجعله نافعاً لكل طالب علم.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎉 Welcome to Maktabatu Rawda!

We are delighted to officially launch the app today — a free platform for seeking Islamic knowledge, an ongoing charity for the sake of Allah.

📚 What the app includes:
• Authentic PDF books in: Fiqh, Hadith, Aqeedah, Arabic & Tajweed, and Seerah
• Audio explanations from trusted scholars and teachers
• The complete Noble Quran — 114 Surahs with ten reciters, plus multiple Mus'haf editions (Colored, Non-Colored, Medina, Qatar)
• All 30 Juz of the Noble Quran
• Detailed content tables for every book
• Reading progress and bookmarks saved
• Fully offline after download

🌿 All content is completely free — no subscriptions, no ads.

We ask Allah to make it beneficial for every student of knowledge.

faq.question: Is everything in this app free?
faq.answer: Yes. All books and audio lessons in مكتبة الروضة are completely free. There is no premium plan, no subscription, and no hidden charges. Everything will always be free.

faq.question: Do I need internet to use the app?
faq.answer: You need internet to download books and audio for the first time. After downloading, everything works fully offline — reading, listening, and tracking your progress.

faq.question: How do I read a downloaded book?
faq.answer: Go to Library → tap a book → tap the PDF card to download. Once downloaded, tap anywhere on the card to open and read the book.

faq.question: Will new books be added?
faq.answer: Yes. New books and audio lessons are added regularly. When you open the app with internet, your library updates automatically — no app update needed.

faq.question: Are the books scholar-verified?
faq.answer: Yes. All books in مكتبة الروضة are authentic Islamic texts taught by qualified scholars. The audio explanations are provided by named scholars shown on each book's detail page.

privacy.title: What we collect
privacy.content: We collect your name and email address when you create an account. This is the minimum required to provide you with a personal reading experience.

privacy.title: What we do NOT collect
privacy.content: We do not collect your location, contacts, camera, microphone, or any personal device data. We do not sell or share your data with any third party.

privacy.title: Authentication
privacy.content: Your account is secured through Firebase Authentication by Google. We do not store your password — it is handled entirely by Firebase.

privacy.title: Reading progress
privacy.content: Your reading progress, downloaded files, and preferences are stored locally on your device. This data never leaves your phone without your knowledge.

privacy.title: Downloaded files
privacy.content: Books and audio files you download are stored privately in your app's internal storage. Only this app can access them. You can delete them anytime from the Downloads tab.

privacy.title: Children
privacy.content: This app is suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13 without parental consent.

settings.aboutDescription: مكتبة الروضة is a free Islamic learning app built to make authentic knowledge accessible to every Muslim student. Browse verified PDF books, listen to scholar explanations, and track your learning — all offline after download.
